newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: South American port conditions - Lloyds.
newsitem.headline: South American port conditions - Lloyds.

text.p: Port conditions from Lloyds Shipping Intelligence Service --

ARGENTINA, July 1 - Santa Fe - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, no vessels due. Max. recommended draft 27 ft. 10 in. at access channel. Diamante - No vessels berthed, no vessels in roads, no vessels due. Max. recommended draft 27 ft. 10 in. at passage KM 520. San Lorenzo - Five vessels berthed of which 2 loading sbmp, 1 loading sbm, 1 loading sbo, 1 loading maize. 6 Vessels in roads, 28 due at 6 terminals during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising about 0.15 metres during next week. Pasa berth draft 21 ft. 10 in. fw. Rosario - Nine vessels berthed of which 1 on orders, 1 under repair, 3 discharging fertiliser, 2 loading fruit, 1 loading sbo, 1 loading maize, 1 loading wheat. 3 Vessels in roads, 12 due during the coming week. The forecast dicates that the draft is rising about 0.15 metres during next week.

Villa Constitucion - One vessel berthed loading maize. 1 Vessel in roads, 3 due. Elevator berths max. draft 22 ft. 0 in. fw. San Nicolas - Two vessels berthed of which 1 discharging magnesite, 1 discharging iron ore. 2 Vessels in roads, 6 due during the week. The forecast indicates that the draft is rising about 0.15 metres during next week. San Pedro - No vessels berthed, none in rods, 1 due. San Lorenzo, Rosario, San Nicolas, San Pedro max. draft 32 ft. 06 in./33 ft. 00 in. fw high tide.

Buenos Aires - 15 Vessels in port, 20 due during the week. Max. recommended draft 31 ft. 06 in. fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Dock sud recommended draft 28/29 ft. fw high tide Naabsa (guided by entrance channel). Necochea - Six vessels berthed of which 3 loading maize, 2 discharging dap, 1 loading fish. 20 Vessels in roads, 11 due during the week. On 25/6 the local coast guard has informed that after carrying out new soundings, it was determined that the access channel has 40 ft. fw at zero level (100 metres wide). Vessels with an loa up to 190 metres can enter/sail with 40 ft. bw. Vessels with loa over 190 metres will be authorised by the coast guard depending on the (weather/swell/tide) at the time the manoeuvre has to be performed.
Bahia Blanca - Three vessels berthed of which 1 loading maize, 1 discharging dap, 1 discharging urea. 2 Vessels in roads, 13 due during the week, draft depends on each berth.

BRAZIL, July 1 - Vitoria - Vessels berthed, 1 bulk wheat discharger, 1 sugar loader, 2 containers/general cargo loaders/dischargers, 1 iron ore loader, 1 cellulose loader, 1 vehicle discharger, 1 granite loader. Tubarao - 2 Iron ore loaders. Praia Mole - 3 Steel products loaders, 1 coal discharger. Portocel - 1 Cellulose loader. Ubu - 2 Iron ore loaders, 11 vessels waiting in roads. Santos - Santos Dock Co administrative employees on strike for an indefinite period from 1900 hours 1/7 and repeated their frequent previous demands for proper definition of payment adjustments, prior to the unilateral enforcement of revised working shifts under the proposed 24 hour operation. Vessels berthed, 2 full container loaders/dischargers, 1 container loader, 1 container discharger, 1 container (ro/ro) discharger, 1 bulk cement, 3 bulk chemical products dischargers, 1 bulk lpg discharger, 4 fertiliser dischargers, 9 sugar loaders, 1 frozen fruit loader, 1 bulk sulphur loader, 3 general cargo loaders, 2 pellets loaders.

Private terminals - Cosipa - 2 Iron ore dischargers, 2 steel products loaders. Ultrafertil - 1 Bulk sulphur discharger. Rio Grande - Vessels berthed, 1 full container loader, 1 soya loader, 1 soybeans loader, 1 fertiliser discharger. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 28 due during next 10 days. Rio de Janeiro - Vessels berthed, 1 general cargo/steel products discharger, 3 paper dischargers, 1 container discharger, 1 vehicles discharger, 1 general cargo discharger, 2 general cargo/steel products loaders, 1 vehicle loader, 2 bulker loaders. 3 Vessels at Tecon, 32 due during next 7 days. Sao Sebastiao - Vessels berthed, Tebar 3 vessels. Commercial quay 1 vessel. 1 Vessel waiting in roads, 8 due during next 7 days.

CHILE, June 30 - Arica - Three vessels in terminal, 3 berths vacant, 8 vessels due during the week. Iquique - Three vessels berthed, 6 due during the week. Antofagasta - Four vessels berthed, 3 berths available, 6 vessels due during the week for loading and discharging concentrates, bulk copper, containers, general cargo. Valparaiso - Six vessels berthed working normally, 3 berths vacant. One berth out of service due to enlargement of pier 2. 15 Vessels due during the week. San Antonio - Six vessels operating, 3 berths vacant, 10 vessels due during the week. Port working normally.

Conception Bay ports - Talcahuano - No vessels berthed, 4 due, none in roads. San Vicente - Two vessels berthed working normally, 1 berth vacant, 6 vessels due. Navy pier (Molo 500) - No vessels due. Steel pier - 1 Vessel berthed, none due. Coronel pier - 2 Vessels berthed, none due. Oil terminal - 1 Vessel berthed, none due. Lirquen - Two vessels berthed, 4 berths vacant, 5 vessels due during the week. Penco - No vessels due. Puerto Montt - Three vessels in port, 4 due during the week. Punta Arenas - One vessel berthed, 3 due during the week.

PERU, July 1 - Callao - Three vessels in bay, 9 in pier (general cargo/containers), no berthing delays. Paita - One fishmeal vessel in pier, no berthing delays. Bayovar, Pisco - No vessels in ports. Talara - Two vessels in bay, 1 in pier (oil), no berthing delays. Chimbote - Three vessels in bay, 4 in pier (fishmeal), no berthing delays. Ilo - Two vessels in bay, 3 in pier (copper/fishmeal), no berthing delays.

VENEZUELA, July 1 - Palua - Two vessels due. Mile 178 - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load. Matanzas - Five vessels operating of which 4 loading steel products, 1 discharging coke, 6 vessels due. Punta Cuchillo - Two vessels loading refined products. San Felix - One vessel due. Orinoco River - Two dredgers anchored at mile 178. Puerto Cabello - 18 Vessels operating of which 17 loading/discharging generals, 1 discharging malt. 11 Vessels due, 1 under repair. Bajo Grande - Two vessels due. La Guaira - Four vessels loading/discharging generals, 5 due, 3 under repair, 1 passenger vessel. Amuay - Two vessels waiting at anchorage to load, 4 loading refined products. Cardon - One vessel waiting at anchorage to load, 3 loading refined products. Guaranao - One vessel loading/discharging generals. Maracaibo - No information received. All ports are working normally.
